source_cn: 讨伐巨龙<Highlight>[巨龙拍卖]</>：%d月%d日（今日）
ref_en: Slay the Giant Dragon <Highlight>[Giant Dragon Auction]</>: %d/%d (Today)
target_ru: Охота на дракона <Highlight>[Аукцион дракона]</>: %d.%d (сегодня)

source_cn:
讨伐的战鼓已然响起，巨龙·投影盘踞猎龙城王城中心。在巨龙周围40米内存活并造成伤害，可为所在团队累计归属伤害。巨龙被击败时，当前有效归属伤害最高的团队取得最终归属。

按最终归属团队全体成员所属俱乐部统计人数，以人数最多的俱乐部为准：该俱乐部在团队内的成员人数超过15人（至少16人）时，归属团队成员及当前分线内该俱乐部的其他成员均可获得拍卖资格；不超过15人时，仅归属团队成员可获得资格。
玩家须在巨龙被击败时位于对应分线，才能获得该次资格。拍卖资格与分红资格一致。
每名玩家每次讨伐巨龙活动最多获得1次拍卖及分红资格，更换团队或分线不会重复获得。
各分线独立结算。同俱乐部其他团队或分线先结算、先开启拍卖，不影响尚未获得资格的玩家在满足上述条件后获得资格。
ref_en:
The war drums for the crusade have sounded, and the Dragon - Projection has entrenched itself in the center of the Dragon Hunting City's royal capital. Survive and deal damage within 40 meters of the Giant Dragon to accumulate contribution damage for your team. When the Giant Dragon is defeated, the team with the highest current effective contribution damage gains the final ownership.

Statistics are based on the Club membership of all members in the final ownership team, determined by the Club with the most members: If that Club has more than 15 members (at least 16) in the team, both the members of the ownership team and other members of that Club within the current channel gain auction eligibility; if it does not exceed 15 members, only the members of the ownership team gain eligibility.
Players must be in the corresponding channel when the Giant Dragon is defeated to gain this eligibility. Auction eligibility is the same as dividend eligibility.
Each player can obtain auction and dividend eligibility at most once per Giant Dragon event; changing teams or channels will not grant additional eligibility.
Each channel is settled independently. If other teams or channels from the same Club settle and start the auction first, it does not affect players who have not yet gained eligibility from obtaining it once they meet the aforementioned conditions.
target_ru:
Боевые барабаны охоты уже бьют: Дракон-проекция обосновался в центре королевского города Охотников на драконов. Находясь в 40 м от дракона и нанося урон, вы накапливаете принадлежащий вашей команде урон. Когда дракон будет повержен, итоговое право получит команда с наибольшим действующим принадлежащим уроном.

Клубы считаются по членам итоговой команды: берётся клуб с наибольшим числом участников. Если в команде состоит более 15 членов этого клуба (не менее 16), право на аукцион получают члены команды и другие члены этого клуба на текущей линии; если не более 15, право получают только члены команды.
Игрок должен находиться на соответствующей линии в момент победы над драконом, чтобы получить право. Право на аукцион совпадает с правом на дивиденды.
Каждый игрок может получить право на аукцион и дивиденды не более 1 раза за охоту на дракона; смена команды или линии не даёт повторного права.
Каждая линия рассчитывается независимо. Если другая команда или линия того же клуба раньше завершила расчёт и открыла аукцион, это не мешает игрокам, ещё не получившим право, получить его при выполнении указанных условий.

source_cn: 输出形态下，在<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="27" color="#f4a067">指定大型竞技玩法</>中获得<HighLight>神血坚壁</>和<HighLight>神血之躯</>效果。<HighLight>神血坚壁</>：若3秒内受到超过自身最大生命值30%的伤害，则接下来4秒内获得50%减伤；<HighLight>神血之躯</>：若3秒内受到超过自身最大生命值50%的伤害，则接下来4秒内单次受到的伤害不超过自身最大生命值的0.5%。每个效果45秒内只能触发一次，并且单独计算冷却。
ref_en: In Damage Form, in <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="27" color="#f4a067">designated large-scale competitive modes</>, gain <HighLight>Divine Blood Bulwark</> and <HighLight>Divine Blood Body</>. <HighLight>Divine Blood Bulwark</>: If damage taken within 3 seconds exceeds 30% of your maximum Health, gain 50% Damage Reduction for the next 4 seconds; <HighLight>Divine Blood Body</>: If damage taken within 3 seconds exceeds 50% of your maximum Health, damage taken from each hit for the next 4 seconds cannot exceed 0.5% of your maximum Health. Each effect can trigger only once every 45 seconds and has an independent cooldown.

source_cn: 还可以，我在贝克兰德技术大学读书，正在做毕业设计。
ref_en: I'm doing alright. I'm studying at Backlund Technical University and am currently working on my graduation project.

source_cn: 还在调查失忆的事吗？对了，您昨天打听过那个钟表匠威廉先生，他以前每天都会来买一份报纸，给<P_Yellow>他母亲</>带回去，他母亲老糊涂了，一直是他在照顾。
ref_en: Still investigating the memory loss? Oh, right, you were asking about that clockmaker, Mr. William, yesterday. He used to come by every day to buy a newspaper to take back to <P_Yellow>his mother</>. His mother is senile, and he has always been the one taking care of her.

source_cn: 还想问问别的事情
ref_en: I would like to ask about something else.

source_cn: 还是个侠盗啊……
ref_en: So you're a chivalrous thief, after all...

source_cn: 还是你想，用你那微薄的薪水，也在金玫瑰找点乐子？
ref_en: Or do you want to find some fun at the Golden Rose with your meager salary too?

source_cn: 还是同样的结局。对他们那种家庭而言，死亡随时可能降临。
ref_en: It's the same ending again. For a family like theirs, Death could descend at any moment.

source_cn: 还是算了，我的份也给你们吧。
ref_en: Never mind, you can have my share too.

source_cn: ——还是算了，改天再来问
ref_en: —Never mind, I'll come back and ask another day.

source_cn: 还是这么热心工作，少加点班，你可不是“不眠者”。
ref_en: Still so enthusiastic about your work. Work less overtime; you're not a "Sleepless".

source_cn: 还有下下个月、下下下个月！
ref_en: And the month after next, and the month after that!

source_cn: 还有其他问题
ref_en: I have other questions.

source_cn: 还有新鲜的苹果派，冷吃猪肉派！
ref_en: There's also fresh apple pie and cold pork pie!

source_cn: 还有这个——封印物“星之帷幕”，它可以抵御来自星空的致命伤害。
ref_en: And this—the Sealed Artifact "Star Curtain." It can ward off fatal damage from the starry sky.

source_cn: 还记得我认识的心理医生吗？她或许能给你答案。
ref_en: Do you remember the Psychiatrist I know? She might be able to give you an answer.

source_cn: 这，这些老板都没跟我说过……他只叫我送棺材出城，然后对外宣布已经火葬。
ref_en: Th-these bosses never told me... He only told me to transport the coffin out of the city and then announce that it had been cremated.

source_cn: 这、这不是单片眼镜变成的那只……蛆吗？
ref_en: Th-this isn't the... maggot that the monocle turned into, is it?

source_cn: 这、这么多奇怪的头衔？阿蒙……
ref_en: Th-that's so many strange titles? Amon...

source_cn: 这……您到底需要多少只？
ref_en: This... exactly how many do you need?

source_cn: 这一次 我们会帮你
ref_en: This time, we will help you.

source_cn: 这一页，该翻过去了！
ref_en: This page must be turned!

source_cn: 这不是我今天带出来的那把。
ref_en: This isn't the one I brought out today.

source_cn: 这不是结束，而是你承载神子命运的开端。
ref_en: This is not the end, but the beginning of you bearing the fate of the God's child.

source_cn: 这不是黑荆棘的标志吗？你怎么有黑荆棘的车？
ref_en: Isn't this the Blackthorn emblem? How do you have a Blackthorn carriage?

source_cn: 这个世界，只有猎人和猎物，你想成为哪一边？
ref_en: In this world, there are only hunters and prey. Which side do you want to be on?

source_cn: 这个世界上有太多为穷人准备的陷阱，你们无法识破的！
ref_en: There are too many traps set for the poor in this world that you cannot see through!

source_cn: 这个分身被植入自毁的念头，他本应在我状态稳定后，在星空中被摧毁。
ref_en: This avatar was implanted with the thought of self-destruction; it was supposed to be destroyed in the starry sky once my condition stabilized.

source_cn: 这个嘛……“归乡”的意义，是时刻提醒你归乡并不容易。 身为“旅行家”，要心怀起点，才不会被远方吞没。
ref_en: Well... the meaning of "Returning Home" is to constantly remind you that returning home is not easy. As a "Traveler," you must keep your starting point in mind so you won't be swallowed by the distance.

source_cn: 这个很简单，首先你要……
ref_en: This is very simple. First, you need to...

source_cn: 这个混蛋，一定是想独吞二十个金镑！
ref_en: This bastard must be trying to hog the 20 gold pounds all to himself!

source_cn: 这个炮筒里……是有一个人吗？
ref_en: Is there... a person inside this cannon barrel?

source_cn: 这个点……如果是今天的话，应该要到了吧？
ref_en: At this hour... if it's today, they should be arriving soon, right?

source_cn: 这个词语的意思是：家乡，心灵与精神的归宿。罗塞尔决定将两个汉字当成特殊的符号教导贝尔纳黛，告诉她，这是她父亲给她的护身咒文，让她永远铭记。她不需要懂相应的意思，只用记住这两个汉字是“故乡”。
ref_en: This term means: hometown, the destination of the soul and spirit. Roselle decided to teach these two Chinese characters to Bernadette as special symbols, telling her that this was a protective incantation from her father, meant for her to remember forever. She didn't need to understand the meaning; she only needed to remember that these two characters meant "hometown."

source_cn: 这个铁罐里装的是什么？
ref_en: What is inside this iron can?

source_cn: 这么多年，这顶红帐篷还在这啊……
ref_en: After all these years, this red tent is still here...

source_cn: 这么巧，正好有人退票？
ref_en: What a coincidence, someone just returned their ticket?

source_cn: 这么说，你不去演出了？海报上还有你的演出宣传。
ref_en: So, you're not performing? Your performance is still being advertised on the poster.

source_cn: 这么重要的事情，我竟然也能忘，该死！
ref_en: How could I have forgotten such an important matter? Damn it!

source_cn: 这么麻烦？听说它能帮人找到回去的路？
ref_en: Is it that troublesome? I heard it can help people find their way back?

source_cn: 这些人看起来已经冻僵多时，应该是残留的魔女力量吸引他们游荡到这里。
ref_en: These people look like they have been frozen for a long time; it must be the residual power of the Witch that attracted them to wander here.

source_cn: 这些都是好几年前的新闻吧？
ref_en: Aren't these news stories from several years ago?

source_cn: 这些钱给你。对了，你见过一个邮差吗？
ref_en: Here is the money for you. By the way, have you seen a postman?

source_cn: 这些钱肯定够了，不信你们数数。
ref_en: This money is definitely enough. If you don't believe me, count it yourselves.

source_cn: 这份病历里写着许多牙齿问题的论述，看上去真是很严重啊。
ref_en: This medical record contains many discussions about dental problems; it looks quite serious.

source_cn: 这位{{先生|女士}}，请原谅保镖们的无礼。
ref_en: This {{gentleman|lady}}, please forgive the rudeness of the bodyguards.

source_cn: 这位先生？黛拉小姐请您上台。
ref_en: This gentleman? Miss Della is asking you to come on stage.

source_cn: 这位先生死前怀着极大的怨恨，灵魂无法安息。现在，我需要完成净化仪式。请不要打断我……
ref_en: This gentleman died with great resentment, and his soul cannot rest in peace. Now, I need to perform a Purification ritual. Please do not interrupt me...

source_cn: 这位是“节制”女士，也是塔罗会的成员。
ref_en: This is Ms. Temperance, and she is also a member of the Tarot Club.

source_cn: 这位是我的哥哥班森，你应该也听说过他。
ref_en: This is my brother Benson; you should have heard of him.

source_cn: 这位绅士出价三十万苏勒，还有更高的吗？
ref_en: This gentleman has bid 300,000 soli. Are there any higher bids?

source_cn: 这位警官处理过很多神秘事件，也许能帮到你。
ref_en: This police officer has handled many mysterious incidents and might be able to help you.

source_cn: 这倒不难办，我可以帮你。
ref_en: That's not hard to handle; I can help you.

source_cn: 这几个位置真不错，视野很开阔。
ref_en: These spots are really nice; the view is very open.

source_cn: 这几天有一个走私美人鱼的团伙经过廷根，教会想趁机剿灭他们。
ref_en: A gang smuggling mermaids has been passing through Tingen these past few days, and the Church wants to take this opportunity to wipe them out.

source_cn: 这句对应的是伯爵从乞丐变成富豪的经历，有趣的命运交换。
ref_en: This sentence corresponds to the Count's experience of going from a beggar to a wealthy man—an interesting exchange of fate.

source_cn: 这只臭鸟每天在售票亭顶等我下班。
ref_en: This stinking bird waits for me to get off work on top of the ticket booth every day.

source_cn: 这只鹦鹉好像和我很熟，但它只会骂人，影响我的社会风评……
ref_en: This parrot seems very familiar with me, but it only knows how to curse, which is affecting my social reputation...

source_cn: 这可不是我们之前说好的价格！
ref_en: This is not the price we agreed upon!

source_cn: 这四把剑，或许就是愚者先生和塔罗会在以他们的方式影响这里，协助我领悟力量，对抗母神的污染。
ref_en: These four swords are perhaps Mr. The Fool and the Tarot Club influencing this place in their own way, assisting me in comprehending power to resist the corruption of the Mother Goddess.

source_cn: 这回就算是死也值回票价了！
ref_en: Even if I die this time, it's worth the price of admission!

source_cn: 这场过家家的游戏，该结束了！
ref_en: This game of house ends now!

source_cn: 这太可怕了……伦纳德先生，威尔，谢谢！
ref_en: This is too terrifying... Mr. Leonard, Will, thank you!

source_cn: 这家伙差点儿把裤衩都输在里面了。
ref_en: This guy almost lost his very underwear in there.

source_cn: 这将是最后的试炼——学会支配你的情绪。
ref_en: This will be the final trial—learn to control your emotions.

source_cn: 这就是他们藏美人鱼的地方？
ref_en: Is this where they are hiding the mermaids?

source_cn: 这就是威尔提过的好运？试试看！
ref_en: Is this the good luck Will mentioned? Let's give it a try!

source_cn: 这就是答案
ref_en: This is the answer.

source_cn: 这就走了，竟然没再来一点恶作剧？
ref_en: Leaving already? And without pulling another prank?

source_cn: 这幅肖像画的是一位略带书卷气的占卜家。
ref_en: This portrait depicts a Seer with a slightly scholarly air.

source_cn: 这幅肖像画的是一位肤色古铜、五官柔和的历史老师。
ref_en: This portrait depicts a history teacher with bronze skin and soft facial features.

source_cn: 这很难，但小丑必须控制好表情和眼神。
ref_en: This is difficult, but a Clown must control their expressions and eyes well.

source_cn: 这才是……
ref_en: This is...

source_cn: 这支巡游车队的主人值得我亲自递上名片。
ref_en: The owner of this caravan is worth me handing over my business card in person.

source_cn: 这是“魔术师”小姐借给我的，现在你也可以用上了。
ref_en: This was lent to me by Miss Magician, and now you can use it too.

source_cn: 这是你的生日礼物。你的一切，今后都由我承担。
ref_en: This is your birthday present. From now on, I will bear everything that concerns you.

source_cn: 这是大家都会有的想法，那么，是什么让你选择醒来？
ref_en: That is a thought everyone would have, so what made you choose to wake up?

source_cn:
这是她卖出的最后一个玩具，她用这个布偶换到了一些毒堇汁，结束了她和她丈夫饥饿超过三天的生命。
这个布偶似乎不具备活着的特性，没有试图逃脱封印的趋向。
<Highlight>持有者</>：黑夜教会。
<Highlight>对应特性</>：
<Highlight>外形</>：穿着1300年前后流行的宫廷长裙，裙摆存在难以洗去的污秽痕迹。
<Highlight>能力</>：厄运相关。
<Highlight>负面效果</>：让身边的人逐渐倒霉，陷入危机，最终一一死去。经过长期的试验，发现只要每天进入它十米范围内累计不超过半个小时，就不会沾染厄运；如果已经厄运缠身，只要将它转移给另外的主人，状况就会好转。
<Highlight>封印方式</>：与人类隔离。
ref_en:
This was the last toy she sold. She traded this doll for some hemlock juice, ending the lives of her and her husband, who had been starving for over three days.
This doll does not appear to possess the characteristics of being alive and shows no tendency to attempt to escape its seal.
<Highlight>Holder</>: Church of the Evernight.
<Highlight>Corresponding Characteristics</>:
<Highlight>Appearance</>: Wearing a court dress popular around the year 1300, with stains on the hem that are difficult to wash off.
<Highlight>Abilities</>: Related to Beset by Misfortune.
<Highlight>Negative Effects</>: Causes those around it to gradually become unlucky, fall into crisis, and eventually die one by one. After long-term testing, it was discovered that as long as one does not enter within a ten-meter radius of it for more than half an hour cumulatively each day, one will not be Beset by Misfortune; if one is already Beset by Misfortune, the situation will improve as soon as it is transferred to another owner.
<Highlight>Sealing Method</>: Isolation from humans.

完成每日、每周与当期贸易任务，解锁阶段宝箱与累计奖励。争夺站点，运送货物；翻开商报，判断瞬息万变的行情，寻找时机，搅动市场的起伏。让贸易再次伟大！
ref_en:
This is the best of times. The Continental Trade Alliance of the Loen continent has spread trade outposts and business opportunities across this land.
Complete daily, weekly, and current trade Quests to unlock stage chests and cumulative rewards. Compete for outposts, transport goods, flip through the business news, judge the ever-changing market trends, look for opportunities, and stir up the market's fluctuations. Let's make trade great again!

source_cn: 那个……
ref_en: That...

source_cn: 那个发光的地方……会是出口吗？
ref_en: That glowing spot... could it be the exit?

source_cn: 那个家伙……总以为自己是非凡的主宰，不知道一次失误就是万丈深渊。
ref_en: That guy... he always thinks he's the master of the extraordinary, not realizing that a single mistake is an abyss.

source_cn: 那个烛台，我明明看着{{他|她}}拿走的！
ref_en: That candlestick, I clearly saw {{him|her}} take it!

source_cn: 那个能完成复仇的——“她”。
ref_en: The one who can complete the revenge—"She".

source_cn: 那么很幸运，{{先生|小姐}} 。你在很年轻的时候就到过贝克兰德，那么以后不管你到哪里去，它的气质都会跟着你。
ref_en: Then you are very lucky, {{Mr.|Ms.}}. You arrived in Backlund at a very young age, so no matter where you go in the future, its temperament will follow you.

source_cn: 那些失忆的人呢？
ref_en: What about those people who lost their memories?

source_cn: 那些消失的念头！
ref_en: Those thoughts that Disappear!

source_cn: 那些被警察压下去的？稍微知道一些。
ref_en: The ones suppressed by the police? I know a little bit about them.

source_cn: 那件非凡物品吸引来的某种特殊存在，让霍克斯男爵察觉了异常，导致了霍克斯男爵的死亡。
ref_en: A certain special existence attracted by that Beyonder item made Baron Hawkes notice the anomaly, which led to Baron Hawkes's Dead.

source_cn: 那位先生没来？真遗憾，我还想再听听他对命运的见解呢。
ref_en: That gentleman didn't come? What a pity, I wanted to hear his insights on fate again.

source_cn: 那位警官就坐在靠窗那张桌子写东西，一直待到打烊。走的时候把笔记本落在桌上了，我追出去还给他，他还说了声谢谢。
ref_en: That officer was sitting at the table by the window writing something, and he stayed until closing time. When he left, he left his notebook on the table. I chased after him to return it, and he even said thank you.

source_cn: 那你呢，你要迎来的是什么样的命运？
ref_en: What about you? What kind of fate are you about to face?

source_cn: 那你要一份今天的报纸做什么？
ref_en: Then what do you need today's newspaper for?

source_cn: 那你说怎么办？
ref_en: Then what do you suggest we do?

source_cn: 那倒不会，虽然它没你的车新，但骑起来很顺畅。
ref_en: That won't happen. Although it's not as new as your car, it rides very smoothly.

source_cn: 那只能等了……贝克兰德这么多大夫里，我还是只信得过他。
ref_en: Then we can only wait... among all the doctors in Backlund, he's the only one I trust.

source_cn: 那可不，我看用不了多久又有新菜可以收了。
ref_en: That's for sure. I don't think it'll be long before there are new crops to harvest.

source_cn: 那可以试试朗齐休息日的特别酒单。
ref_en: Then you could try the special drink menu on Lonzi's day off.

source_cn: 那天晚上，有人跟我说，可以帮我找回我的孩子。我明知不可能……可还是来了。
ref_en: That night, someone told me they could help me find my child. I knew it was impossible... but I came anyway.

source_cn: 那太糟糕了，我可不想戴上单片眼镜。
ref_en: That's terrible. I certainly don't want to put on a monocle.

source_cn: 那家伙可笨了，要是没人告密，他几乎没可能抓到我！
ref_en: That guy is so clumsy; if no one had tipped him off, he would have almost no chance of catching me!

source_cn: 那家伙帐篷门都懒得迈，哪会注意到售票亭里的员工！
ref_en: That guy is too lazy to even step out of his tent, how would he ever notice the staff in the ticket booth!

source_cn: 那富豪怎么办？忽然变成乞丐，命运跌入谷底？
ref_en: What about the rich man? Suddenly becoming a beggar, with his fate hitting rock bottom?

source_cn: 那就分头行动，我和{{他|她}}去排查音乐厅，保护露丝和爱丽丝。
ref_en: Then let's split up. {{He|She}} and I will go check the music hall and protect Ruth and Alice.

source_cn: 那就好！
ref_en: That's good!

source_cn: 那就好，可以进行下一步了。
ref_en: That's good, we can proceed to the next step.

source_cn: 那就是少了点苏勒，请你吃冰淇淋花掉了。
ref_en: That's just a few soli short; I spent it on ice cream for you.

source_cn: 那就这么说定了，我等着你们丰收。
ref_en: Then it's a deal. I'll be waiting for your harvest.

source_cn: 那就难办了，你带路，我们去布置仪式的地方！
ref_en: That makes things difficult. You lead the way; we're going to the place where the ritual is being set up!

source_cn: 那当然！鲁恩人只会吃土豆番茄卷心菜，这些菜苗可是我和老詹好不容易培育出来的。
ref_en: Of course! Loen people only eat potatoes, tomatoes, and cabbage. These seedlings were not easy for Old James and me to cultivate.

source_cn: 那您听听这句台词。
ref_en: Then listen to this line.

source_cn: 那您撞上大好运了！刚好有个傻瓜，五分钟前退了张包厢票。
ref_en: Then you're in luck! A fool just happened to return a box ticket five minutes ago.

source_cn: 那我们先去问问马戏团的人！
ref_en: Then let's go ask the circus people first!

source_cn: 那我们先走一步……祝您好运！
ref_en: Then we'll be heading off first... Good luck!

source_cn: 那我们打个赌吧？
ref_en: Shall we make a bet?

source_cn: 那我可不说。行吧，我同意了。
ref_en: I'm not saying. Fine, I agree.

source_cn: 那我就不客气了，多谢。
ref_en: Then I won't stand on ceremony. Thank you.

source_cn: 那我是否可以说，劳维斯太太和索尔斯都是注定在近期死亡的人。
ref_en: Then can I say that Mrs. Lawis and Solis are both people destined to be dead in the near future?

source_cn: 那我要叫它小白。
ref_en: Then I'm going to call it Little White.

source_cn: 那我该怎么申请呢，队长？
ref_en: Then how should I apply, Captain?

source_cn: 那我还是躺回去吧，省得被发现……麻烦帮我把盖子盖上。
ref_en: Then I'd better lie back down, lest I be discovered... Please help me put the lid back on.

source_cn: 那是，我可是血族侯爵。对应序列3的召唤大师，能让灵界深处的强大生物来到现实世界。你可以试试这份召唤契约，它应该还能用。
ref_en: Of course, I am a Sanguine Marquis. Corresponding to the Sequence 3 Summoner, I can bring powerful creatures from the depths of the Spirit World into the real world. You can try this summoning contract; it should still work.

source_cn: 那是求救……还是警告……
ref_en: Was that a cry for help... or a warning...

source_cn: 那是调查结束后的事，并且，是你自己说要喝酒的，怎么现在倒问起我来了？
ref_en: That was after the investigation concluded, and besides, you were the one who said you wanted to drink. Why are you asking me about it now?

source_cn: 那样它就不特别了呀！
ref_en: That would make it not special anymore!

source_cn: 那索尔斯呢？他会拥有什么样的结局？
ref_en: What about Solus? What kind of fate will he have?

source_cn: 那边应该也有阿蒙分身在活动，但力量层次都比较低。
ref_en: There should be Amon Avatars active over there as well, but their power levels are relatively low.

source_cn: 那边有熟悉的身影
ref_en: There is a familiar figure over there.

source_cn: 那重新认识一下，{{PlayerName}}，一名专门处理神秘事件的警察。
ref_en: Then let's reintroduce ourselves. {{PlayerName}}, a police officer specializing in handling mystical incidents.

source_cn: 邦尼：你伤我的每一分，都有它替我承受，只有你会精疲力竭。
ref_en: Bonnie: Every bit of pain you inflict on me is borne by it instead; only you will suffer from Exhaustion.

source_cn: 邦尼：你赢了，小种子。
ref_en: Bonnie: You win, little seed.

source_cn: 邦尼：你还记得，两年前在铁十字街救走的小女孩吗？如今，她在我的花园里开得很漂亮，你想不想见她？
ref_en: Bonnie: Do you remember the little girl you saved on Iron Cross Street two years ago? She is blooming beautifully in my garden now. Would you like to see her?

source_cn: 邦尼：别担心，我不会杀他。毕竟，得有一个观众……来见证你的蜕变。
ref_en: Bonnie: Don't worry, I won't kill him. After all, there must be a Spectator... to witness your transformation.

source_cn: 邦尼：动手吧，别让我也变成没有意识的怪物。
ref_en: Bonnie: Do it. Don't let me turn into a mindless monster too.

source_cn: 邦尼：哈哈哈哈哈，不错，你和花种融合得非常完美，但是……
ref_en: Bonnie: Hahahaha, not bad. You and the flower seed have fused perfectly, but...

source_cn: 邦尼：它在告诉我，你很想了解我——真正的我。
ref_en: Bonnie: It's telling me that you really want to understand me—the real me.

source_cn: 邦尼：我就舍弃一切！追逐力量！拥抱疯狂！一定让你血债血偿！
ref_en: Bonnie: I will abandon everything! Chase power! Embrace Madness! I will definitely make you pay in blood!

source_cn: 邦尼：我用二十年，追逐力量，从本杰明变成邦尼……但还是输了。
ref_en: Bonnie: I spent twenty years chasing power, changing from Benjamin to Bonnie... but I still lost.

source_cn: 邦尼：我要你明白，明白我为这一切，付出了什么。
ref_en: Bonnie: I want you to understand, to understand what I have sacrificed for all of this.

source_cn: 邦尼：把我和这二十年的仇恨一起埋葬了吧。这是我，最后的请求……
ref_en: Bonnie: Bury me along with these twenty years of hatred. This is my final request...

source_cn: 邦尼：来吧！向我证明，你有被培育的价值！
ref_en: Bonnie: Come! Prove to me that you are worth cultivating!

source_cn: 邦尼：终于来了。我亲爱的种子，还有，廷根的阴影。
ref_en: Bonnie: You've finally arrived. My dear seed, and the shadow of Tingen.

source_cn: 邦尼：至于你……我能感觉到你体内“种子”的跳动。
ref_en: Bonnie: As for you... I can feel the beating of the "seed" inside your body.

source_cn: 邦尼：这是我唯一能对死去之人，许下的承诺。
ref_en: Bonnie: This is the only promise I can make to the dead.

source_cn: 邦尼：这样的我救不了任何人，既然如此……
ref_en: Bonnie: A version of me like this cannot save anyone. Since that's the case...

source_cn: 邦尼：进来吧，小种子。看看邦尼是如何一步步走到今天的！
ref_en: Bonnie: Come in, little seed. See how Bonnie walked step by step to where he is today!

source_cn: 邦尼：镜子，碎了……我的力量，我的复仇，都结束了……
ref_en: Bonnie: The Mirror... has shattered... My power, my revenge, it's all over...

source_cn: 邦尼在里面埋了“花种”，会让你的灵性遭受污染。
ref_en: Bonnie has buried "flower seeds" inside, which will cause your spirituality to suffer corruption.

source_cn: 邮差 邮差 邮差
ref_en: Postman Postman Postman

source_cn: 邮差一定躲在这里……会在哪里呢？
ref_en: The postman must be hiding here... where could he be?

source_cn: 邮差不见了……
ref_en: The postman has disappeared...

source_cn: 邮差也有休假的权利，我请了两天调休假。
ref_en: Postmen have the right to take time off too; I took two days of compensatory leave.

source_cn:
邮差忽然捏单片眼镜，狡黠一笑，威尔侧头瞥向邮差。
小丑谢幕完毕起身，竟然全部嘴角上扬，戴上单片。
只有中间芬奇没有戴，他猛然醒悟，表情极度惊恐。
ref_en:
The postman suddenly adjusts his monocle and gives a cunning smile; Will tilts his head to glance at the postman.
The Clown finishes his curtain call and stands up, all of them wearing upturned smiles and putting on monocles.
Only Finch in the middle does not wear one; he suddenly realizes the truth, his expression one of extreme terror.

source_cn: 邮差是阿蒙分身……是他导致金玫瑰身份和命运的错位？
ref_en: The postman is an Amon Avatar... Was it him who caused the displacement of the Golden Rose's identity and fate?

source_cn: 邮差突然出现
ref_en: The postman appears suddenly

source_cn: 邮差落座
ref_en: The postman sits down

source_cn: 部分人脉好感度不足，未能加入展台。
ref_en: Insufficient favor with some contacts; failed to join the display stand.

source_cn: 部分人脉未拥有，对应人脉角色未套用

source_cn: 部分飞升
ref_en: Partial Ascension

source_cn: 部分飞升效果
ref_en: Partial Ascension effect

source_cn: 都不对，我不是他们……我是……
ref_en: None of it is right, I am not them... I am...

source_cn: 都动起来啊伙计们！今天怎么了？平时也没见你们食欲不振啊……
ref_en: Get moving, guys! What's wrong with you today? I've never seen you lose your appetite like this before...

source_cn: 都很精美！
ref_en: They are all exquisite!

source_cn: 都是棋子……都是大帝的棋子……
ref_en: They are all pawns... all pawns of the Emperor...

source_cn: 鄧恩
ref_en: Dunn

source_cn: 酒类克星
ref_en: Alcohol Bane

source_cn: 酒馆收购轻醇冰白

source_cn: 酣战淋漓

source_cn: 醇厚的选择，您打算再加入些什么呢？
ref_en: A mellow choice; what else would you like to add?

source_cn: 醒了？感觉还好吗？
ref_en: Awake? How are you feeling?

source_cn: 醜
ref_en: Ugly

source_cn:
采用位掩码如下，例：需要同时监听添加buff（1）和buff重置时间（64），可以填1+64=65
    AddBuff = 1, -- 添加BUFF
    RemoveBuff = 2, -- 移除BUFF
    AddLayer = 4, -- 叠加BUFF层级
    RemoveLayer = 8, -- 移除BUFF层级
    AddLevel = 16, -- BUFF增加等级
    RemoveLevel = 32, -- BUFF减少等级
    ResetTime = 64, -- 重置时间
    ResetMaxLayer = 128, -- 重置最大层数
    ResetInstigatorID = 256, -- 刷新始作俑者
    Destroy = 512, -- 销毁BUFF（目前仅有肉鸽丢卡牌是该项）
ref_en:

铁路大亨每局开始时的商会票券分成两部分：

2：工坊物产带来的额外票券，物产的等级越高，能提供的票券数量越多，最多可以携带三类物产，携带的最大总量由火车升级的等级决定
ref_en:
The Chamber of Commerce tickets at the start of each Railway Tycoon game are divided into two parts:
1: Tickets initially granted for each route, with the amount provided by the Chamber of Commerce based on the route's difficulty.
2: Additional tickets brought by workshop products. The higher the level of the product, the more tickets it can provide. You can carry up to three types of products, and the maximum total quantity you can carry is determined by the train's upgrade level.

source_cn:
附加赛结束后结算参与奖励，按附加赛对局第1至第4名设置四档，奖励内容、数量分别与神话组第一周第1至第4名参与奖励一致。具体获得条件以赛事奖励界面为准。
第二轮附加赛及筛选积分结算完成后，各赛区分别按俱乐部最终筛选总积分排名，本赛区前8名俱乐部晋级天启组，并获得战略服参与资格。战略服结算时，筛选阶段赛区前三名俱乐部可额外获得神选席位：<Highlight>第1名10个，第2名5个，第3名5个</>。
ref_en:
Participation rewards are settled after the playoffs conclude, categorized into four tiers based on the 1st to 4th place rankings in the playoff matches. The content and quantity of the rewards are identical to the participation rewards for the 1st to 4th place in the first week of the Mythical Group. Please refer to the tournament rewards interface for specific acquisition conditions.
After the second round of playoffs and the screening points settlement are completed, each region will rank clubs based on their final total screening points. The top 8 clubs in each region will advance to the Apocalypse Group and gain qualification to participate in the Strategic Server. Upon settlement of the Strategic Server, the top three clubs in the region during the screening phase can receive additional God-Chosen seats: <Highlight>1st place 10, 2nd place 5, 3rd place 5</>.
